# Desert Launch

> Desert Launch is a software development company in Cairo, Egypt. It builds custom mobile apps (Flutter, iOS and Android), web platforms, MVPs and internal business systems for clients in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Europe and the United States.

Last updated: 2026-09-15

## Key facts

- Founder and lead engineer: Abdullah Mohamed, based in Cairo, Egypt. More than 5 years shipping production web and mobile products. He designs and builds every project personally.
- Structure: an independent software studio, not an agency. There are no account managers between the client and the engineer.
- Project languages: English and Arabic. The website is translated into French, Spanish and German for discovery, but project work is conducted in English or Arabic only.
- Time zone: Cairo, UTC+2 in winter and UTC+3 in summer — within one hour of every Gulf capital.
- First reply to an enquiry: within 12 hours, usually faster.
- Contact: abdullah@desertlaunch.dev, WhatsApp +20 102 283 8534.

## Who Desert Launch builds for

Business owners, founders and operations managers who need software built and are not going to build it themselves. The usual situations:

- A business running on spreadsheets, paper records, phone calls or WhatsApp messages where there should be bookings, orders or job tickets.
- A company that needs a mobile app for its customers, for its staff, or for both.
- A founder with an idea that needs the smallest working version in front of real users.
- An operation whose existing app or platform is slow, broken, or abandoned by whoever built it.
- A team that needs a customer portal, an admin dashboard or an internal system shaped around how it actually works.

No in-house technical team is needed. Most clients are not technical: the technical decisions are made for them and explained in plain business language, in English or Arabic.

## How to get in touch

- Project and business enquiries: WhatsApp +20 102 283 8534 is the fastest route, or email abdullah@desertlaunch.dev. A free scope call comes first, with no obligation and no commitment to a quote.
- Developer, partnership and collaboration enquiries: welcome by email at abdullah@desertlaunch.dev. These are read and answered, but they go to email rather than WhatsApp, which is kept clear for client projects.

## Services

1. Mobile app development — one Flutter codebase published to the App Store and Google Play. Typical duration 2–4 months. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/mobile-app-development/
2. Web development — business websites, client portals, admin dashboards and full web platforms. Typical duration 2 weeks to 3 months. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/web-development/
3. MVP development — the smallest version that proves an idea with real users. Typical duration 1–2 months. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/mvp-development/
4. UI/UX design — screens and flows agreed before development, including Arabic right-to-left layouts. Typical duration 1–3 weeks. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/ui-ux-design/
5. Rebuilds and modernization — taking over a slow, broken or abandoned product, starting with a written verdict on the existing code. From 2 weeks. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/rebuilds-and-modernization/
6. Technical consulting and architecture — a second opinion, an architecture review or a delivery plan you own. 2–5 days. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/technical-consulting/

## Pages written for a specific situation

- Gym and fitness booking apps — membership plans, trainer availability, session booking and in-app payment. Backed by Q-Fight Gym, live on both stores. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/gym-booking-app/
- Field service management apps — a customer app, a technician app and a manager view built from one codebase, with live tracking. Backed by Ezhal. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/field-service-management-app/
- Lab and clinic management systems — a customer portal plus an admin dashboard, with role-based access and file storage. Backed by Xera Lab. https://www.desertlaunch.dev/services/lab-and-clinic-management-system/

## Commercial terms

- Free scope call first, with no obligation.
- A fixed price quoted in USD, in writing, before any commitment. Never hourly billing.
- Payment across three or four milestones: 30% upfront, the remainder per delivered milestone. A milestone is working software the client can open, and is not invoiced until accepted.
- The client owns the source code, the intellectual property, and the hosting, domain, storage and app store developer accounts. These are created in the client's name from the start.
- Twelve months of free support and maintenance after launch. Small changes and updates are also free for the first three months.
- Running costs (hosting or Firebase, plus the Apple Developer Program at 99 USD/year and Google Play's one-time 25 USD registration) are billed to the client's own accounts and estimated in the quote.
- NDAs are signed on request, before the scope call.
- There is no published price list, and no number can be quoted without a scope call: the same brief can differ by a factor of three depending on how many kinds of user it has. What drives the price, what is excluded, and what the price includes are all set out at https://www.desertlaunch.dev/pricing/

## Technology

Flutter and Flutter Web; Node.js; PostgreSQL; Firebase; GraphQL and REST APIs; AWS and Docker; Nginx; Riverpod; JWT role-based access; Stripe, MyFatoorah and PayTabs payment gateways; full Arabic and right-to-left interface support with Hijri dates.

## Products built and shipped

Every product below was designed and built by Abdullah Mohamed — across Desert Launch client work and earlier senior engineering roles. Voicers is an in-house product and is not published.

- Q-Fight Gym — booking app for a professional Muay Thai gym in Doha, Qatar. Flutter and Firebase with payments. Live on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/q-fight-gym/id6759147399) and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.qfightgym.app). Case study: https://www.desertlaunch.dev/work/q-fight-gym/
- Al-Muslim — daily companion app: Quran, adhkar and duas, location-based prayer times and qibla. Bilingual Arabic/English. Live on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/al-muslim-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%84%D9%85/id6757352101) and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elmuslim.app). Case study: https://www.desertlaunch.dev/work/al-muslim/
- Ezhal — multi-role car-service platform: three role-specific apps (customer, field technician, manager) from one Flutter codebase, with live tracking, subscriptions, wallet, points and Apple Wallet passes. Delivered to the client. Case study: https://www.desertlaunch.dev/work/ezhal/
- Xera Lab — dental case management platform: a customer portal and admin dashboard on a Node.js and PostgreSQL API with JWT role-based access and AWS S3 storage. Delivered to the client as a private production system. Case study: https://www.desertlaunch.dev/work/xera-lab/
- FasTap — NFC digital business card. A Flutter app writes profiles to NFC cards and a Flutter Web page opens from every tap-to-share link. Delivered to the client.
- Jaweb — competitive trivia game with team scoring, referee logic and MyFatoorah payments. Delivered to the client.
- ICCD Hub — bilingual members' app for the Islamic Corporation for the Development of the Private Sector, pairing organisational content with a personal productivity suite. Delivered to the client.
- Voicers — bilingual social audio platform: voice notes, playlists and live stages. Built in-house; not published.

Two of these eight are published on public app stores; the store links above are the verifiable ones.

## Process

1. Scope call — a free call about how the business runs today. Output: a written scope summary and an honest go or no-go.
2. Quote — a fixed price in USD, a milestone plan and a date. Nothing starts before written approval and the 30% deposit.
3. Build — working software at every milestone, with updates on WhatsApp and same-day answers.
4. Launch — store submission, hosting, domains and analytics set up in the client's own accounts.
5. Support — twelve months free, with small changes free for the first three.
